title: Jupiter Scope

cover_image.alt: a screenshot of the SNES game Jupiter Scope, from Super Action 52. It shows a space ship shooting a beam at a meteor in front of a night-time cityscape.

description: A basic shooter game where you destroy meteors falling toward Earth. Based on the Action 52 game of the same name.

title: TAPATAN

cover_image.alt: A screenshot of an SNES game called Tapatan, it is a variant of tic-tac-toe several blue and pink game pieces are seen in a 3x3 grid. The game field is a pink speckled field. A cursor shows the current player's position. Text on the left side shows the current game mode and player.

description: A tic-tac-toe variant, where you can only place three pieces at a time.

title: Micro Mike

cover_image.alt: A screen shot of an in-progress SNES game called Micro Mike. It shows a small baby on a purple field.

description: Based on the game of the same name from Action 52. This version is meant to play like Flappy Bird

title: SPÄTI

cover_image.alt: A screenshot of an in-progress SNES game called SPÄTI. The screenshot shows an image of a white sign with the text 'FIELD CLOSED' in red. In-game text at the bottom of the screen says 'I used to take walks, sometimes as late as 3:00AM'

description: A text adventure game showing photographs from long walks. The title comes from a nickname for a Spätkauf (literally 'late purchase'), or store that is often open late in Germany. Roughly equivalent to a bodega.
